deadlines.label: UCAS deadline (LSE undergraduate programmes)
deadlines.notes: As stated on the LSE course pages (13 January 2027); UCAS closes at 18:00 UK time. Economics also requires the TMUA.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Not required if you are a national of Canada or a UKVI majority English-speaking country and your first language is English, or you completed a 3-year undergraduate degree, a 1-year postgraduate taught degree or a PhD in one of those countries. Proof is only requested if LSE makes an offer.

english.notes: IELTS Academic (including online), one sitting only; valid for 2 years before 1 September of entry.
Old 0-120 scale; one sitting only; valid for 2 years before 1 September of entry.
Updated 1-6 scale (tests from January 2026): 5.5 overall, at least 5 in Writing, Reading, Listening and Speaking.
PTE Academic, in-person test only; 70 overall with 70 in all components in one sitting.
C1 Advanced or C2 Proficiency: 185 overall and 185 in each component, one sitting.

tier_notes.general: Complete University Guide 2027 overall ranking: 3rd of 130 UK universities (S = ranks 1-5 on the national scale).
